title: Gloomhaven: Jaws of the Lion
subtitle: A fully cooperative campaign of tactical combat in the Gloomhaven universe.
tagline: You are the Jaws of the Lion.
loreSummary: You are a renowned mercenary group known as the Jaws of the Lion. Lately, people have been disappearing in the city, and it falls to you to investigate the mystery.
keyFeatures: Learn to play with an integrated tutorial
No assembly required - play right in the scenario book

milestones.title: Welcome to the Jaws
milestones.description: Learning the ropes and tracking down the source of the missing persons.

milestones.title: The Cult Revealed
milestones.description: Discovering the Blood Tumor cult and their dark plans for the city.

milestones.title: The First of the Order
milestones.description: Stopping the First of the Order and saving Gloomhaven from a terrible fate.
